description: WaterCorp CIP Planned Assets Drainage (Points) WCORP (WCORP-012) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Corporation. The Water Corporation CIP Planning Layer is a spatial dataset representing the spatial extent of the Water Corporation’s 5 year capital investment program. All future water, wastewater and drainage capital investment projects that are growth driven are represented. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Corporation. Its tags are Harvested, drainage, future, infrastructure, planned. It offers 8 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, FGDB, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
